name: Memory and Obsidian
description: Local markdown memory conventions and Obsidian/Tailscale note-link rewriting for Signal replies.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL
requiredConfig.description: Tailnet URL used to rewrite local markdown links into phone-openable Obsidian redirects.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_MEMORY_ROOT
requiredConfig.description: Local memory root; must be instance-owned.

privateDataPolicy: Do not store memory contents, task contents, vault paths tied to one user, or private note names in the plugin manifest.
